title: AI-driven 3D vectorcardiography improves prediction of obstructive coronary artery disease
summary: In a prospective blinded study of 183 patients with possible CAD, a clinical risk model had an AUC of 0.617 for obstructive coronary disease on invasive angiography, rising to 0.716 with AI-driven 3D vectorcardiography. A neural network computed parameters including a perfusion factor from the recording. The cohort is small, discrimination is modest, and the model derivation set is not described in the abstract; this is a version 1 preprint.
ai_technology: Neural network algorithm computing 3D-vectorcardiography parameters, including a perfusion factor, to estimate obstructive CAD probability
organization: University Hospital in Halle; Martin Luther University Halle-Wittenberg

evidence.tested: Prospective blinded comparison with invasive coronary angiography in 183 patients.
evidence.unknown: Derivation data, FFR-defined disease and larger-cohort performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Estimates the probability of obstructive coronary lesions from the recording.
